title: StatusArtifact
description: Canonical input to truth.review: a stamped evidence container. kind and schema_version are required; the initiative declares name/owner/objective; policy splits observation-age from source-content-age; sources and claims are required; claims MUST be reviewed Claims (claim.schema.json), never CandidateClaims. The engine also accepts deprecated compatibility forms (captured_at, sourceId, plain-string source references, max_source_age_days alias) and reports them as deprecation findings.

as_of.description: Reproducible review cutoff timestamp; required so evidence-age checks are deterministic.

max_observation_age_days.description: Maximum allowed age of the observed_at snapshot in days; older observations raise stale_observation.

max_source_content_age_days.description: Maximum allowed age of the source content (source_updated_at) in days; older content raises stale_source_content.

claims.description: Reviewed claims only; candidate capture output must be promoted to Claims first.

baseline_timeline.description: Baseline plan timeline; when both timelines are present the review reports timeline drift.
